summary: Fix verified public MCP Guard no-write and projection-quality failures. Public alembic_code_guard with explicit files and no primeRef/workRef currently changes the real AlembicWorkspace SQLite guard_violations table/WAL, contradicting the demand's all-five-tools request-scoped read-only contract and final acceptance prohibition on live knowledge mutation. Make the public MCP path analyze only a confined read-only snapshot and never persist violationRuns, guardHits, primeAdoptions, or other effects; preserve explicit-scope coverage, violations, applicable Recipe rules, primeAlignment observation, no-KB truth, confinement, and public schemas without falsely reporting persisted feedback. Keep persistence only on real non-public owning surfaces. Refactor the public projection so the same Guard scope genuinely passes ast_method_complexity for projectGuardPublicResult (currently 24 > 20) without suppressing rules. Add RED/GREEN fingerprints for passing, violating, and primeRef calls including DB/WAL/vector/knowledge stats/guard_violations; run focused/full/check/build/package/distribution/plugin verification; commit only AlembicPlugin. No Test, rescan, real-project/live-data/Core/vendor/release/marketplace/gate/environment changes.
sourceRef: Controller post-restart five-tool isolation: public Guard alone changes guard_violations/WAL; Prime/Search/Recipe Map/Graph remain read-only. Guard also reports projectGuardPublicResult complexity 24 > 20.
designIntent: Make public Plugin MCP Guard genuinely request-scoped and read-only while preserving explicit-scope analysis/results, and simplify the public projection without changing its schema.

required.verify: RED/GREEN proves violating, passing, and primeRef public Guard calls do not change live DB, WAL, vector index, knowledge stats, or guard_violations.
Explicit-file Guard keeps complete coverage, real violations, applicable Recipe rules, no-KB truth, confinement, and public schemas.
Guard passes on touched public output/handler files; projectGuardPublicResult complexity is <=20.
Focused tests, full unit suite, check, build, runtime-package, distribution, and Codex-plugin verification pass.
Exact AlembicPlugin commit, changed files/symbols, and two-stage self-review.
